title: Convergence of $k$-point functions in high dimensional percolation
summary: We establish first-order asymptotics for the $k$-point connectivity function in critical Bernoulli percolation on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ assuming $d>6$ and Hara's two-point asymptotic. For every $k\ge 3$ and distinct macroscopically separated locations, the probability that the corresponding lattice points lie in the same open cluster, rescaled by $n^{(4-d)(k-1)-2}$, converges as $n \to \infty$ to an explicit sum of integrals indexed by trees.
